role: The 'clock' item icon's animated TextureAtlasSprite: each tick it eases a smoothed angle toward the world's celestial angle and advances the texture frame, so the dial spins.

members.name: TextureClock
members.note: the sprite comes from the dump

members.name: updateAnimation
members.note: off the surface the target is the client stream's Math.random (clientworld_tick_input draws it)

notes: Clocks are reachable in-game through villager trades (csrc/engine/trades.c lists item 347), so the icon can appear in a HUD slot. The vanilla dial is randomized off-surface via the oracle hook netherite.oracle.Det.mathRandom() (visible in this file's source), which is the oracle's determinism pin, not new behavior.
